wholeP01Critical.description: 2.4 Add actual adapter/DTO/filesystem/bootstrap/keyboard/overlay RED tests, then implement only closed paths. Validate authorization/bounds/exact health keys, filesystem queue/readback/failure, dual-ready first paint, distinct Settings/contextual chord/focus/dirty guard, safe native callback identity and DOM-only Draw.io bridge with poisoned forbidden APIs. Run actual Electron dirty KA + native + pinned frame before/after XML/JSON/paint/preferences/undo/selection/identity, Enter/Esc/outside/window-close/restart/OS/failing-frame cases. Record exact two-occurrence transitions preserving 122 entries and old tests; update P01 BDD hashes/docs. Reproduce existing metadata check loading/error/success, FlowManager empty/loading/error/populated/dirty/read-only/warnings/hover/focus, bundle hint and native/embedded reconnect menu/alertdialog without feature behavior/source edits; assert actions/drafts/membership/undo/document bytes.

2.5 Capture real welcome/picker, dirty object editor, native diagram, embedded Draw.io and open overlay/Settings for Light/Dark/HC × compact/comfortable at 1280×850/DPR1/loaded fonts, plus 1600×900, 850×650 and 200% text zoom. Confirm actual forced/coarse/reduced media, keyboard/focus/labels/live failures/targets/contrast/domain preservation and explicitly disclosed exceptions; obtain human approval of new screenshot baselines. Pin benchmark KA/native/frame datasets with paths/counts/hashes and identified i9-9880H Windows hardware BEFORE measurement; run 20 warmups + 100 alternating requests and nearest-rank p95 <=150ms from accepted request through painted barrier/required ACKs/durable publication, excluding only explicitly deferred native chrome. Save actual outcomes; missing evidence blocks closure. Include every accepted B02 consumer/state in computed foreground/background/effective contrast and visible-focus checks across six theme/density states plus actual forced media and existing approved viewport captures; unavailable reproducible state is BLOCKED, not fabricated PASS.

3.2 Perform OpenSpec verification against all requirements/scenarios/tasks, then freeze full manifest and obtain independent gpt-6-astra/xhigh read-only POST PASS. No production edits during gate; correctness/architecture/applicable check blockers mean FAIL. Preserve received report and exact candidate integrity.

3.3 After every required check, verify, POST and human visual acceptance PASS, sync/archive by project workflow and run post-archive compliance. Preserve cumulative/historical evidence and report actual final state; STOP before P02.
